notes.title: Day 1 Update - Fixed Achievement Bugs
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am pleased to announce that I have just pushed the Day 1 update fixing 2 achievement bugs which has been reported by some of the players. So, here it is. 
The achievements in question are:
1. 11 Level Unlocked.
2. 11000 Stars Achieved.

The achievements should now work as intended and if you encounter any further issue please let me know in the discussions section. Thanks to your patience! I hope you will enjoy the game.

Best Regards,
Anamik
